method: Municipal representative points from the existing Census town data. Postal codes are associated through recorded public venue addresses or exact nearby New Jersey GeoNames populated-place records. ZIPs may cover several municipalities; these are town centers, not ZIP centroids, street addresses, routes or driving distances.
